meta.notes: Age classes verified against IWU 2015 Bild 1 (identical to the brief). U-values W/(m²K) are the component values of the IWU example buildings in the original state (no refurbishment), i.e. without the extra resistance of unheated attics/basements (use F_roof/F_floor or b-factors separately). Residential reference area in IWU/TABULA is the conditioned net floor area A_C,ref; GEG classes use A_N. 'estimated': true marks any value not read directly from a cited source table; see archetypes_sources.md.
meta.schemaNotes: envelope.<type>.<class>: U_roof/U_floor are the example building's own elements (roofIs/floorIs); U_roofPitched, U_topCeiling, U_basementCeiling, U_slab let the consumer pick by OSM roof/basement info; 'reuse' lists which of these came from another type/class and those values must be treated as estimated even when the entry's 'estimated' flag is false (the flag refers to U_wall, U_roof, U_floor, U_window, dU_tb). pkgUsual/pkgAdvanced: per-example refurbishment packages. Section notes that used to be '_' keys are in meta.sectionNotes; global physics defaults (F_floor, F_roof, frameFrac, shading, heatedFrac) are in meta.defaults.

typeLabels.ab: 大型公寓楼，13 户及以上（GMH）

typeLabels_en.ab: Large apartment block, 13 or more dwellings (GMH)

defaults.F_floor_src: TABULA adjustment factor b_tr = 0.50 for basement ceiling to unheated cellar and for slab on ground (IWU2015 calculation sheets p.87 and p.100)
defaults.F_roof_src: derived: TABULA MFH_E sheet reduces top-ceiling U 0.60 -> 0.51 for the unheated attic (b=1.0), i.e. effective factor 0.85; DIN V 4108-6 Tab. 3 (Fx≈0.8) not verified
defaults.shadeWinter_src: TABULA external shading reduction factor F_sh = 0.6 for vertical windows, 0.8 horizontal (IWU2015 p.75, p.87)
defaults.shadeCtrl_note: external movable blinds reduction factor F_C (estimate; GEG Anlage 5 uses F_C <= 0.30 as requirement for simplified residential proof)
defaults.heatedFrac_note: estimate; DIN V 18599-10 handles partial heating via a_tb (EFH 0.25, MFH 0.15 co-heated share) — see profiles.residential.a_tb

periodDefaults.notes: n50: estimated typical values for unrefurbished buildings; GEG §26 limits for new buildings tested by blower door are 3.0 1/h (no mechanical ventilation) and 1.5 1/h (with RLT). n_inf_tabula: infiltration air change used by TABULA for existing buildings (0.20 1/h, IWU2015 p.87); TABULA new-build variant with MVHR uses 0.05 1/h (p.100). Cm in J/(m²K) per net floor area using ISO 13790 class values (80k light / 165k medium / 260k heavy); TABULA itself uses 45 Wh/(m²K) = 162 kJ/(m²K) for all buildings (IWU2015 p.87, p.100). Cm_mfh_ab: suggested heavier class for multi-storey concrete-slab buildings D–H (estimate).

systems.basis: eta = useful heat delivered to rooms / final energy, referred to net calorific value H_i (GEG/DIN V 18599 basis), generation+storage+distribution+emission. IWU/TABULA expenditure factors are H_s-based and were converted with H_s/H_i = 1.11 (gas), 1.06 (oil), 1.08 (wood).

carriers.note: fp = non-renewable primary energy factor; co2 in g CO2-eq per kWh final energy (H_i). Law text: Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz (GModG, formerly GEG), gesetze-im-internet.de/geg, last amended 23.07.2026; Anlage 4 and 9 values unchanged since 2020/2023.

zensusMap.lt1919: estimated. Germany-wide (Zensus 2011, IWU2015 Tab. 4) pre-1860 buildings are 22 % of the pre-1919 residential buildings (15 % of dwellings, 17 % of living area). Munich's pre-1919 stock is dominated by Gründerzeit growth and was heavily rebuilt after WWII, so A is set to 0.10 (plausible range 0.03–0.20).

hpModel.formula: COP = carnotEta * T_sink[K] / (T_sink - T_source); T_sink = supply temperature (plus ~3 K condenser approach optional)
hpModel.supplyT_note: design supply temperature at design outdoor temperature; floor 35 °C and radiator 55 °C are the maximum distribution temperatures of the IWU K/L new-build heat-pump variants (IWU2015 Tab. 23, p.126); 70 °C for unrefurbished old radiator systems is an estimate

referenceArea.rule: A_N = 0.32 m^-1 * V_e (DIN V 18599-1:2018-09 Gl. 30). If the mean storey height h_G (floor surface to floor surface of the storey above) is > 3 m or < 2.5 m: A_N = (1/h_G - 0.04 m^-1) * V_e (Gl. 31). Top (attic) storeys are excluded when averaging h_G (DIBt Auslegung XIX-4). V_e = gross heated volume enclosed by the thermal envelope (external dimensions).

modernisation.definition: Probability that the component of a building of this construction period has been modernised after construction (wall/roof/floor: post-construction insulation of at least part of the element; windows: windows of installation year ≥1995, i.e. low-e glazing; heating: main heat generator replaced at least once). Germany-wide, all residential buildings.
modernisation.windowsCaveat: IWU 'original state' U_window 2.7–3.0 for classes A–H already represents later double insulating glazing (IWU sheets: 'in späteren Jahren modernisiert, Original-Fenster nicht mehr erhalten'); the Bernoulli event 'windows' therefore means upgrade to low-e glazing (U≈1.3–1.6), not replacement of single glazing.

partialArea.note: If modernised, mean insulated fraction of the element area, buildings up to 1978 (IWU2018 Tab. 15; roof/floor fractions taken over from Datenbasis 2010 Tab. 4.1-2). About 7.9 % of buildings up to 1978 had wall insulation already at construction (IWU2018 footnote 55).

modernisation.projection: value = p2016 + (1 − p2016)·(1 − (1 − r)^10) with r = annual share of buildings with a measure 2010–2016 (IWU2018 Tab. 43; up to 1978: wall 1.51 %, roof 2.52 %, floor 0.67 %, windows 4.39 %/a; 1979–1994: all-building rates 1.05/1.69/0.46/3.33 %/a; 1995+: half of those). Range = [p2016, p2016 + 10·r] (capped 0.95). Post-2016 activity is not measured here; treat as estimate.
modernisation.regional: Differences between regions are small for buildings up to 1978 (IWU2018 Tab. 19: old Länder South wall 25.4 %, roof 53.4 %, floor 14.4 % area-insulated vs. all Germany 27.8/54.9/14.2 %; large/medium cities 27.3/55.4/13.4 %).
modernisation.heatingNote: Main heat generator renewal rate 2010–2016: 3.27 %/a (buildings up to 1978), 2.69 %/a (1979–2009), 2.64 %/a in old Länder South (IWU2018 Tab. 54). In 2010 only 6.6 % of gas boilers and 16.3 % of oil boilers were older than 1987 (Datenbasis 2010 Tab. 5.7-2). 'heating' values are estimates derived from these.

typicalUAfter.method: U = 1/(1/U0 + d/λ) with mean post-construction insulation thickness for buildings up to 1978 (IWU2018 Tab. 33: wall 9.0 cm; Tab. 35: roof/top ceiling 13.3 cm; Tab. 38: floor 7.7 cm), λ = 0.035 W/(mK) (roof λ_eff = 0.045 for rafters), U0 = 1.4 / 1.0 / 1.2; window U implied by IWU 2022 working paper Tab. 3 (mean 2016 window U 2.11/2.04 at 54/60 % modernised share and 2.7 unmodernised → ≈1.6)
typicalUAfter.alternative: TABULA usual package (refurb.usual) is better than the stock average of past retrofits
typicalUAfter.src_thickness: IWU2018 Tab. 33 (wall 9.0 cm), Tab. 35 (roof/top ceiling 13.3 cm), Tab. 38 (floor 7.7 cm): mean post-construction insulation thickness, buildings up to 1978
typicalUAfter.src_window: IWU2022 working paper Tab. 3: mean window U 2016 of 2.11 (EZFH) / 2.04 (MFH) at 54 % / 60 % modernised share and 2.7 unmodernised, implying about 1.6 for modernised windows
